description: Create a one-page quick reference sheet for a board game. The document should include sections for 'Turn Structure', 'Common Actions', and 'Phase Reference'. Use clear formatting with headings, bold text for emphasis, and organized lists (bullets or numbers) to make the information scannable during gameplay. A rulebook excerpt is provided at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/game_rulebook_excerpt.txt for reference. Save the completed reference sheet as GameReference.docx.
